title: Smells good not packaged well
text: Smells good not packaged well. Smells good but with the way they were packaged, I don't think they'll last very long. I've bought other brands that didn't have powder coming out the package & lasted a good while. These look like somebody opened the main box and then a couple of boxes inside.

product_metadata.title: Attracts Money - Box of Six 20 Gram Tubes - HEM Incense
features: Quality incense from HEM, one of the leading incense makers in India.
Box containing six 20 gram (around 20 sticks each) tubes of incense.
